name: Tower Hall Funabori
accessSummary: Toei Shinjuku Line Funabori Station North Exit: about 1 min walk
hours: Room usage times are morning 9:00-12:00, afternoon 13:00-16:30 and evening 17:30-21:30, and all day 9:00-21:30 (including preparation and cleanup time). For the Event Hall and Horai, the categories are 2 hours 30 minutes for wedding receptions and banquets and 3 hours for meetings and others.
notice: A facility of Edogawa Ward. Companies and groups from outside the ward can also rent rooms. To apply, you must register with Edonet, Edogawa Ward's reservation system, and companies and groups register at the counter as a "Large Cultural Facility User Group (outside the ward)" (for groups the ward deems appropriate to use the facility; by mail or through a proxy is not possible; submit identification and documents showing the group actually exists, such as a company profile; renewal every 2 years). Only group registrations can enter the lottery; individual registrations can only make reservations for open slots. Groups with an office in Edogawa Ward pay the ward resident rate, and all others pay the general rate. Commercial purposes are allowed with conditions. Use for exhibition sales of goods or direct sales of products for profit, and use for continued group activities for profit, are not approved. For events that charge an admission or participation fee, the venue usage fee is increased according to the amount (1,001-2,000 yen: 50% surcharge; 2,001-3,000 yen: 75% surcharge; 3,001 yen and above: 100% surcharge). If the purpose of an event is unclear, or the event is not suitable for a public facility, we may decline to rent. The lottery for the Large Hall, Small Hall and Exhibition Hall (for exhibition purposes) is held 12 months before, and for the meeting rooms and other rooms 5 months before, from 9:00 on the 5th to 22:00 on the 14th. For the Event Hall and Horai, both the lottery and reservations for open slots are at the counter only. Usage time includes preparation and cleanup. Cancellations are in principle not refunded. Use of open flames requires an application to the fire department. Posting notices is not allowed, and trash must be taken home. In the Event Hall and meeting rooms, drums, wind instruments and sound through amplifiers (including loud voices) are not allowed.

ops.loadingHours: The hall-dedicated service yard is open 7:00-23:00.
ops.vehicleRules: The load-in entrances are: for Large Hall users only (entrance height 3.8 m, 3 vehicles), for Exhibition Hall users only (entrance height 3.5 m, 2 vehicles), and for Small Hall users only (entrance height 3.7 m, 2 vehicles). The overpasses on the load-in route are 3.6 m and 4.2 m high.
ops.parking: Basement 1 has 74 spaces and basement 2 has 87 spaces (161 in total). The height limit is 2.6 m, and there are also spaces for people who need wider parking spaces, such as wheelchair users. Hours of use are 8:30-22:00. The fee is 200 yen for the first hour and 100 yen for each hour after that. The lot may be full depending on events, and the use of public transportation is recommended.
ops.waitingRooms: The Large Hall dressing rooms are 5 rooms on the 4F (No. 1: Japanese-style 6 tatami mats with shower; No. 2: Western-style 18㎡ with shower; No. 3: Japanese-style 11 tatami mats; No. 4: Western-style 31㎡; No. 5: Western-style 51㎡). The Small Hall dressing rooms are 4 rooms on the 5F (No. 1: Japanese-style 12 tatami mats; No. 2: Western-style 37㎡; No. 3: Western-style 25㎡; No. 4: Western-style 23㎡). The waiting rooms for the 2F Event Hall are Matsu, Sakura and Fuji (38 seats, capacity 12). Fees are listed in the fee schedule.
ops.catering: For the 2F banquet rooms (Event Hall and Horai), according to the guidance of Funabori Matsuya Salon, bringing in food and drink is in principle not accepted for food hygiene reasons. For the Large Hall, Small Hall, Exhibition Hall and meeting rooms, eating and smoking outside designated places is discouraged, and drinking alcohol outside designated places is not allowed. Eating and drinking in the hall seating area is discouraged.
ops.restaurants: On the 7F is the restaurant "Salon de Salon" (11:00-21:00, last food order 20:00, drinks 20:30, open every day of the year). On the 1F are Caravan Coffee (9:00-19:00), Kirin City (Mon-Sat 11:30-23:00, Sun & holidays 11:30-22:00) and Tsukiji Uemura Shunsenbo (11:00-15:00, 17:00-22:00).
